description: Requires a HousingFeed key. Search the listings in your licensed feed by city, ZIP, rent, bedrooms or map box. Returns up to 50 per call with a total; page with offset.

full.description: true = every field of each listing, including description and photos.

max_beds.description: Maximum bedrooms. Same as min_beds for exactly N.

max_lat.description: North edge of a map box.

max_lng.description: East edge of a map box.

min_lat.description: South edge of a map box.

min_lng.description: West edge of a map box.

name: search_my_feed
title: My feed: search listings
